draftBefore.emotion: a warm, pleasant sensation of enjoyment while tasting something delicious
notes: As an adjective, 'dulce' is used for anything with a sugary taste. When used as a noun, 'el dulce' refers to candy or a sweet treat.
It can also be used metaphorically to describe a pleasant, kind, or gentle personality.
